# Kingdom Civics

> Christian civic education for Hamilton, Ontario and beyond. Live public records, biblical principles, prayer resources, and Kingdom Lens research.

Kingdom Civics helps Christians understand government, discern leadership, pray faithfully, and serve humbly—without partisan endorsements.

## Canonical site

- https://kingdom-civics.vercel.app/

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://kingdom-civics.vercel.app/): Christian civic education hub with Hamilton live data
- [Why Engage](https://kingdom-civics.vercel.app/why-engage): Biblical case for Christian civic engagement
- [Hamilton Leaders](https://kingdom-civics.vercel.app/leaders): Mayor Andrea Horwath, councillors, MPs, MPPs with official source links
- [Hamilton Elections](https://kingdom-civics.vercel.app/elections): October 26, 2026 municipal election
- [Kingdom Lens](https://kingdom-civics.vercel.app/kingdom-lens): Ask civic questions with cited sources and Scripture
- [Biblical Principles](https://kingdom-civics.vercel.app/biblical-principles): Transparent framework for evaluating public life
- [Pray](https://kingdom-civics.vercel.app/pray): Prayer prompts for government leaders
- [Serve](https://kingdom-civics.vercel.app/serve): Pathways into public service
- [Trust Center](https://kingdom-civics.vercel.app/trust): Methodology, source standards, corrections

## Key facts (Hamilton, Ontario, Canada)

- Mayor: Andrea Horwath (City of Hamilton)
- City Council: 15 ward councillors + mayor (16 members)
- Next municipal election: October 26, 2026
- Official city site: https://www.hamilton.ca
- Data last verified: 2026-08-08

## Key facts (mission)

- Nonpartisan Christian civic education
- No candidate or party endorsements
- Scripture-grounded principles (Jeremiah 29:7, 1 Timothy 2:1–2, Micah 6:8)
- Kingdom first—not party first

## API

- Kingdom Lens research API (POST JSON): https://kingdom-civics.vercel.app/api/kingdom-lens
  - Body: `{ "question": "Who is the mayor of Hamilton?" }`
  - Returns sourced answers with Scripture, uncertainties, and disclaimers
